newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain- Soy offers down, corn nearbys slip.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain- Soy offers down, corn nearbys slip.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean offers dropped on Wednesday while nearby corn values slipped one cent a bushel amid lackluster export activity, dealers said.
Soft red winter and hard red winter wheat basis values were little changed. The focus was on the hot, dry conditions in pockets of the eastern corn belt.
Dealers cited slow export demand and scant farm sales. "The farmer wants higher prices and the export buyer wants cheaper prices," one U.S. exporter said.
On the export front, Pakistan was seeking 500,000 tonnes optional wheat for August 11-September 10 shipment on July 28.
